recommender_samples_step1_titles: How can I handle this properly?
recommender_step1_samples: Recently, I recorded a TV drama with the intention of viewing it at a later time. I'm wondering if this act of directly videotaping TV dramas that are broadcast at home infringes upon copyright laws.
Is it necessary for me to stamp "copy" on a photocopy of someone else's ID card?

I'm inquiring on behalf of a friend who is employed on a ship. My friend's company has recently installed a CCTV system, asserting that it provides comprehensive surveillance coverage from various angles. However, the office frequently adjusts the CCTV to monitor the interior of the ship's cabin, with the intention of ensuring security and observing my friend's activities. Does this practice potentially violate personal privacy rights?

The incense next door is really stinky and unbearable I thought I could finally get a house in a 30-year-old private housing estate I thought it would be okay if it is not a haunted house, but little did I know the people who lived on my floor were crazy. Someone always forcefully closes the door. They keep opening and closing the door dozens of times a day (they have already entered the house, so I have no idea why do they keep opening and closing the door with great force. My child was woken up by the sound several times. I’ve complained but it doesn’t work) On the other side, the flat next door light the incense three times a day, in the morning, afternoon and evening, even more frequent than my meals It's really unbearable. Basically, every time I go out they coincidentally start incensing. I've already placed a lot of sponges and used air purifiers in the house. But the smell would go into my house when I open the door slightly to go out. The worst thing is when they finished lighting the incense they would close their door. If they like it so much they should enjoy the smell in front of their door. It is a completely meaningless thing to light incense. It's none of my business if their house becomes a temple. The problem is that they always light the incense at the door but the corridor is not ventilated and I am living next door, which is really unbearable. Do you have the same experience or solutions?

recommender_description: The CLIC Recommender is an AI recommendation system designed to assist users in efficiently finding relevant legal information on the Community Legal Information Centre (CLIC). It analyzes users' input, whether it is a legal scenario or a legal question, and provides recommendations for the corresponding CLIC pages based on the input description. Users can access relevant legal information through these recommended pages.

howto_usage_body: With the CLIC Recommender, users simply need to provide a description of their legal scenario. The AI tool will intelligently analyze the users' situation, transform their concerns into suitable legal questions and get recommended relevant pages.
howto_feature_titles: Use Jumpstart samples to test quickly
Ask for recommendations without asking questions
Preview of recommended CLIC pages without going to the page
howto_feature_bodies: Not sure how to describe your scenario or just want to try out the tool? You can easily get started by leveraging our jumpstart samples. Simply click on the yellow blocks provided, and you'll have access to pre-written content that can help you get started or inspire your own ideas.
You do not need to type questions in your input to get recommendations. Simply input a situation with context and let the Recommender do the searching for you.
The recommender will automatically fetch the excerpt that best fits the input and topic you choose. You can read the previews before diving into the extensive information on CLIC.
howto_step_titles: Visit relevant CLIC page for information
howto_step_bodies: Type in your situation or legal question into the text box and click “Continue”. If you are not sure what to type, feel free to click on the yellow boxes aside in the desktop version and test with a sample input.

The Recommender will return several topics that are available on CLIC and relevant to your input. To find more topics (if any), click “Show More”. Click on the tags to select all the applicable topics. After selecting all your topics, click “Search”.

The Recommender will return a maximum of 10 model questions that are relevant to your situation at a time. For each question, you have the option to click on “Preview Relevant Excerpt” to show the content from the CLIC page to which the question relates. To find more questions (if any), click on the page numbers or arrows (' > ' , ' >| ') at the bottom of the page.
If the preview appears to be closely connected to your situation, feel free to click the “Visit Page” button to access the complete content on CLIC to obtain more detailed information.
howto_feedback_body: You can help us to improve the Recommender by rating the usefulness and applicability of each of the pages recommended. Please give the recommendation a 5 stars if the information is very helpful, and 1 star if the recommendation is irrelevant.
howto_feedback_contact: If you have any questions related to the Recommender, please fill in the feedback form on our [[link]]
